description: This file exports configuration functions for Vitest testing framework tailored for a WhatsApp extension, including loading include patterns from environment variables and creating a scoped Vitest configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include file patterns from environment variables or default environment object, returning an array of patterns or null.

methods.name: export function createExtensionWhatsAppVitestConfig( createExtensionWhatsAppVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for WhatsApp extension tests, with default patterns based on environment variables or predefined roots.
